name: Suprascapular Neuropathy
definition: Compression or traction neuropathy of the suprascapular nerve causing posterior shoulder pain and weakness of supraspinatus/infraspinatus.

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostics localize lesion; MRI/ultrasound identifies ganglion or muscle denervation.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Space-occupying compression or persistent motor deficit may require decompression.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Compression or traction neuropathy of the suprascapular nerve causing posterior shoulder pain and weakness of supraspinatus/infraspinatus.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
